_comment: Mutation testing config — see ADR-042. Initial scope: src/utils/**/*.ts (the layer Vitest coverage measures). .astro components and build scripts are excluded — their behaviour is exercised by Playwright and the Container API microtests, neither of which Stryker can drive efficiently in this template's setup.
_ignoreComment: Stryker copies the project into a fresh sandbox per run, so anything a test or perf run writes to must be excluded. A concurrent Playwright run crashed mutation testing on 2026-09-08 with ENOENT on test-results/.last-run.json — the copy raced the write. The .pnpm entry matters for a different reason: a local pnpm store there is ~595MB, and the sandbox resolves dependencies through a node_modules symlink, so copying it was pure waste. Asserted by scripts/src/stryker-config.test.ts.
